clue.text: Insect that kills fools in East European river

parts.note: two fools are two asses, ass meaning a silly person
the Bug is a river running through Ukraine, Poland and Belarus

explanation.surface: Some deadly insect makes fools of people along a river in Eastern Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: The assassin bug is a predatory insect named for stabbing and killing its prey.

clue.text: 10's work has unwise translation, an idiot's

parts.note: rendered in French, 'has unwise' is a pas sage, literally has not wise

indicators.note: translation turns the letters of the following words into another form, so they are rearranged

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A novelist's book is said to be a foolish rendering by some idiot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'translation' does double service in spirit: 'has unwise' put into French gives A PAS SAGE, and 'translation' rearranges AN IDIOT into TO INDIA; the 's adds no letter. 10 is FORSTER, so this is one of his novels.
explanation.definitionFit: E. M. Forster wrote the 1924 novel set in British India about the Marabar Caves incident.

clue.text: The common man a forger?

definitions.meaning: the most common English surname stands for any ordinary person
a metalworker who forges iron at an anvil

explanation.definitionFit: The surname is famously the commonest in England, and the trade name means one who forges metal.

clue.text: Southern shire loves to go ahead

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for south or southern
Hamp is a short form of Hampshire, a county in southern England
love is zero in tennis, written O, so two loves are OO

explanation.surface: A southern county's sweethearts are urged to press on.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a pun: to wash hair is to 'go a-head', working on the head.
explanation.definitionFit: Washing someone's hair means working over their head, read as a punning 'go a-head'.

clue.text: Princess at home to supporter and volunteers

parts.note: someone who is at home is in
a fan supports a team or star
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force

explanation.surface: A princess is relaxing at home with an admirer and a band of volunteers.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spanish or Portuguese king's daughter bears this royal title.

clue.text: Poet to fish by his stream

parts.note: Robert Burns, the national poet of Scotland
the ide is a freshwater fish, also called the orfe

explanation.surface: A poet goes fishing beside the brook he loves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'his' points back to the Scottish poet, and burn is the Scots word for a stream, so beside his stream is the burnside.
explanation.definitionFit: A burn is a Scottish brook, and the land along its bank is the burnside.

clue.text: Got ready for action: there's a fly about, a male, eaten by an amphibian

indicators.note: the fly goes around the word there, enclosing it

parts.note: a gad is a gadfly, a biting fly
the word there, the 's being a link meaning is

indicators.note: being eaten puts one piece inside another, the eater

parts.note: a toad is an amphibian
he is a male person

explanation.surface: A fly buzzes about and a man is swallowed by a toad, in a bizarre nature scene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' and 'eaten by' are the two container signals. The phrase is about a boil ripening, not a fly, so the insect picture misleads.
explanation.definitionFit: A boil that has gathered to a head is ripe and ready to burst, so the phrase means poised to act.

clue.text: 10's work: people of quality and intelligence have one inside and a line outside

indicators.note: the row of things goes round all the rest, sitting outside it

parts.note: a row is a line of things
OM is the Order of Merit, given to people of great distinction
wit means intelligence or quickness of mind

indicators.note: one is placed inside the word have

parts.note: taken as written
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A novel's characters are distinguished and clever, with one in their midst and a queue around them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' and 'outside' are the two container signals. OM, the Order of Merit, is a British honour. The novel's full title begins with A, which the clue drops.
explanation.definitionFit: E. M. Forster wrote the 1908 novel set partly in Florence about Lucy Honeychurch.

clue.text: Almost cure it in paved area with some necessary forethought

indicators.note: the cure and it go inside the paved area

parts.note: a patio is a paved area by a house

indicators.note: almost means the word falls one letter short of complete

parts.note: a remedy is a cure

indicators.note: some of the word necessary is just its opening letter

explanation.surface: A gardener plans to repair a patio with forethought.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Almost' cuts REMEDY to REMED; with IT it goes 'in' PATIO, then N from 'some necessary' ends it.
explanation.definitionFit: Premeditation is planning in advance, the same idea as forethought.

clue.text: Instrument put into car in a hurry

indicators.note: the instrument is put, or placed, within the words that follow, spanning them

explanation.surface: Someone hurriedly bundles a musical instrument into a car.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'intO CAR IN A'; 'hurry' just finishes the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The ocarina is a small egg-shaped wind instrument made of clay.

clue.text: Writer in favour of canonising the Queen?

parts.note: for means in favour of
canonising makes someone a saint, ST
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: Someone supports making the Queen a saint.
explanation.definitionFit: E. M. Forster was an English novelist, the theme of this puzzle.

clue.text: Grotesque folk: is Cumbrian village guarded by them?

indicators.note: being guarded means being surrounded, so the village sits inside

parts.note: men are folk, people
Shap is a village in Cumbria in northern England

explanation.surface: Ugly locals guard a village in Cumbria.
explanation.definitionFit: Something misshapen is deformed, which is what grotesque describes.

clue.text: Source of energy for second XI?

parts.note: a cricket or football team has eleven players, written XI

explanation.surface: A reserve side asks what drives them.
explanation.definitionFit: Steam drives engines and turbines, so it is a source of power.

clue.text: I have a shot at playing a villain

parts.note: a go is a shot or attempt

explanation.surface: An actor hopes to try out as a stage villain.
explanation.definitionFit: The schemer in Shakespeare's Othello is literature's archetypal villain.

clue.text: 10's work in D?

parts.note: the final letter of the forename Howard is D, so D is that name's end, which is a Forster title

explanation.surface: A novelist's book appears in the key of D.
explanation.definitionFit: Forster's 1910 novel about the Schlegel sisters and a country house is the title meant.

clue.text: Tough pre-development of sixties' bestseller

indicators.note: developing the letters works them up into a new shape

explanation.surface: A tough prelude to the growth of a popular sixties book.
explanation.definitionFit: Mary McCarthy's 1963 novel about Vassar graduates was a major bestseller.

clue.text: Undercover timbers produce light from shells?

parts.note: to hatch is to produce chicks out of their shells
beams are rays of light

explanation.surface: Chicks break out of eggshells, giving off light.
explanation.walkthrough: Hatch beams are the timbers that support the covers over a ship's hatches.
explanation.definitionFit: Hatch beams are timbers that sit beneath and hold up a ship's hatch covers.

clue.text: Qualify to have a bird in the French holding

indicators.note: en le holds the bird between its two words

parts.note: the French for 'in the' is en le
a tit is a small bird

explanation.surface: Someone qualifies to keep a bird in French custody.
explanation.definitionFit: To entitle someone is to give them the right or qualification to something.

clue.text: 10's work has a number of golden grains

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
Au is the chemical symbol for gold
rice is a grain

explanation.surface: A novelist's work contains many golden grains.
explanation.definitionFit: Forster's novel of gay love, published after his death in 1971, has this title.

clue.text: Result of test: don't change after all

indicators.note: the answer is what results from the letters of test reworked

explanation.surface: After a test, the advice is not to change anything.
explanation.walkthrough: STET is the proofreader's mark cancelling a correction, letting the original stand after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Stet is a printer's instruction to restore text that was marked for deletion.

clue.text: It's splendid about the feminine element being in competition

indicators.note: very good goes round the feminine element

parts.note: VG, very good, is what one writes for something splendid
yin is the feminine principle in Chinese philosophy

explanation.surface: Someone praises the feminine side in a contest.
explanation.definitionFit: Vying means competing, the state of being in competition.

clue.text: Amid utter destruction, give audience to sincerity

indicators.note: amid places one piece in the middle of the other
destruction breaks the letters of utter apart to be rebuilt

parts.note: to give audience is to hear

explanation.surface: In the midst of utter ruin, someone listens to honesty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'destruction' rearranges the letters to TRUET, and 'Amid' puts the listening word within it; 'utter' looks like an adjective but is the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A true heart is one that is sincere and faithful, so the phrase stands for sincerity.

clue.text: Small house added to German dog

parts.note: ho is a short form of house
und is German for and, meaning added to

explanation.surface: A tiny home is built on to a German's.
explanation.definitionFit: A hound is a dog, especially one bred for hunting.

clue.text: Last demon to be converted to saint

indicators.note: converting changes the form of the letters of demon

explanation.surface: Finally, a demon converts and becomes a saint.
explanation.definitionFit: Endmost means furthest towards the end, which is last.

clue.text: One crazy guy has endless love before he's born

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a nut is a crazy person

indicators.note: endless means the last letter goes

parts.note: Eros is the god of love

explanation.surface: A mad fellow falls in love before his birth.
explanation.definitionFit: In utero is Latin for in the womb, the state of a baby not yet born.

clue.text: Caught by radical paper, female having had near death experience?

indicators.note: radical means changed at the root, so the letters of paper are rearranged

parts.note: a hen is a female bird

indicators.note: near means not quite, so a letter is dropped

parts.note: to die is to experience death, so the past tense is died

explanation.surface: Someone is arrested for a radical paper by a woman who nearly died.
explanation.walkthrough: 'radical' rearranges PAPER to APPRE; 'near' drops the I of DIED to leave DED, 'nearly died'.
explanation.definitionFit: To apprehend a suspect is to catch or arrest them.
